Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CSA questionnaire — focused control list + evidence ask

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking this on. We completed our questionnaire intake and want to limit the initial evidence pull to the controls listed below to accelerate our audit window. Can you provide a mapping of Redwood's control claims (CSA/CAIQ assertions) to the StratosHealth control IDs and a short set of artifacts we can use for sampling?

Controls of interest (first pass):
- LOG-03 (runtime telemetry retention & integrity)
- KMS-02 (key management lifecycle)
- INF-08 (tenant isolation assertions)
- CRY-04 (data-at-rest encryption proof)

Requested deliverables and timeline:
1) Control mapping table (for each control: Redwood claim, evidence file/stub, control owner) — by 2027-04-08
2) Representative artifacts or logs for sampling (redacted where necessary) — by 2027-04-12

I've attached our RFI/worksheet to this email for context. If you prefer a narrower scope or need help narrowing which sub-controls we should prioritize, let me know and we can trade off which ones to include.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — our audit kickoff is 2027-04-13.

Best,
Elaine Wong
Senior IT Auditor
StratosHealth

Attachments: Stratos_RFI_CSAQ_20270403.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks, and good to hear the audit window. We can support the subset you listed. I'll coordinate control owners internally and deliver a compact mapping and an evidence index ahead of your kickoff.

Immediate plan:

- Internal owners assigned (provisionally): Marissa Cole (runtime logs / LOG-03, INF-08 sampling), Kimberly Park (KMS-02, CRY-04)
- Target: preliminary mapping and evidence index to you by 2027-04-08; deliver artifacts or redacted log samples by 2027-04-12

Two quick asks for StratosHealth:
1) Confirm that log redaction (PII removal) is acceptable for sampling; if you need full unredacted logs we will need a scoped transfer agreement and an upload method (SFTP or temporary signed GCS bucket).
2) Please confirm whether you want host-level KMS key rotation proof or tenant-level key manifests (we can provide both but they have different artifacts).

I'll share a Drive folder and populate the template over the next 48 hours. If the scope needs to be trimmed further, tell me which of the four controls to keep as highest priority.

-Karthik
